subtitle: A report listing which hosts provided nine small TCP services in 1983.

tldr.problem: The author wanted to know which hosts listed in the NIC hostname table provided the small TCP services tested.
tldr.mechanism: The report lists hosts for Echo, Discard, Active Users, Date and Time, Netstat, Quote of the Day, Character Generator, Time, and Finger.
tldr.outcome: It provides a host-by-service snapshot from tests conducted in February and March 1983.

facts.label: Most listed hosts for one service

today: RFC 848 is a survey report of small TCP services found on listed hosts during tests in 1983. It records observed availability rather than specifying the services.

sections.title: The Services in the Survey
sections.content:
The memo lists nine services: Echo, Discard, Active Users, printable Date and Time, Netstat, Quote of the Day, Character Generator, Time, and Finger. It gives the TCP port number for each service.

The test list came from the NIC hostname table dated 24 February 1983. The tests were run from ISI-VAXA on February 23 and 24 and March 3 and 5.
sections.plainLanguage: The report checked nine small services, including Echo, Discard, Time, and Finger. It says which listed hosts answered for each service.

sections.title: How the Results Are Organized
sections.content:
The RFC presents tables with host names and addresses grouped by service. It includes separate lists for Active Users, Date and Time, Echo, Discard, Netstat, Quote of the Day, Character Generator, Finger, and Time.

The number shown with each service heading is the count of hosts listed for that service.
sections.plainLanguage: Each table is organized around one service and lists the hosts that provided it. A count appears beside each service name.

sections.title: Reading the Survey as a Snapshot
sections.content:
The report describes results from tests on the listed hosts during the stated dates. It is a survey of which services those hosts provided, rather than a definition of how a service works.

The host lists preserve both host names and addresses so readers can see which machines answered each service test.
sections.plainLanguage: The document records which tested hosts offered each service at that time. It does not specify the service protocols.
